title: Walk cycle: fixed orthographic, in place (treadmill)
description: The user's tested treadmill prompt: no root motion, for cycles only. Baseline for the side-track A/B.

body.subject: Fixed orthographic {{view}} view of this armoured warrior, exactly as in [start_image]: {{design_lock}}.
body.action: He walks in place, as on a treadmill, at a steady natural pace of {{cadence_spm}} steps per minute, arms swinging opposite the legs.
body.camera: Locked-off camera: no camera movement, no zoom, no cuts, no perspective change.
body.style: Flat even studio light, plain light-grey backdrop.
body.constraints: Feet always in frame and touching the floor line. Exactly two arms and two legs, same armour design throughout.

design_lock.default: dark bronze plate armour, gold lion-head pauldrons, crimson cloth skirt with a gold meander hem, black undersuit
design_lock.description: what must stay unchanged: the design in words

start_image.description: the orthographic view in the start pose

bytedance/seedance*.note: names references in prose; roles are start_image / end_image / video references

higgsfield/*.note: Higgsfield media roles: start_image, end_image, image_references, video_references

heygen/*.note: audio is always on and not controllable; only a first frame is taken
